name: Human Cloning
overview: Scripture reveals that human beings are uniquely created by God in His own image and likeness, as affirmed in Genesis 1:26-27, highlighting the divine origin and dignity of human life. God personally formed man from the dust and breathed life into him, underscoring the sacredness of human life as a living soul (Genesis 2:7). The Lord is our Creator and Father who has established us, and we belong to Him, not to ourselves (Deuteronomy 32:6; Psalms 100:3). Therefore, attempts to replicate or manufacture human life through means such as cloning must be understood in light of God’s sovereign and personal act of creation, with caution against making any likeness or image forbidden by God’s covenant (Deuteronomy 4:23).
